message.content: Both claims were tested with on-device probes and decisively rebutted: the measured relative L2 error is 0.0236 (well under the 0.08 tolerance), the output is finite, and float32 rounding shifts the error by only ~1.3e-8. The contract's only in-scope case is the fixed make_inputs() workload, so no new claims are warranted.
